description: Compare a regulation's usage between two months: the biggest risers and fallers, Pokémon that newly reached meaningful usage and Pokémon that dropped out. Use it to see how the metagame changed. Needs at least two months of history.

format.description: Regulation id from list_formats. Defaults to "champions-regmc" (Pokémon Champions — Regulation M-C).

from.description: First month, YYYY-MM. The nearest month with data is used if it has none

limit.description: Maximum entries to return (1–25). Defaults to 10

months.description: Months to look back from `to` when `from` is omitted. Defaults to 3

to.description: Last month, YYYY-MM. Defaults to the most recent month

name: get_meta_shifts

changePoints.description: Change in usage, in percentage points

rank.description: Usage rank in the last month

format.description: Regulation id the result applies to

changePoints.description: Change in usage, in percentage points

rank.description: Usage rank in the last month

title: Compare usage between two months
